A service costs either $42.00 per month for unlimited sessions or $7.00 per session with no monthly fee. Ignoring tax, what is the minimum whole number of sessions in a month for unlimited service to be strictly cheaper?
explanation: Unlimited is strictly cheaper when $42.00 < sessions × $7.00. Sessions must exceed 6.0000, so the minimum whole count is floor(42/7) + 1 = 7.
